summary: This change adds dedicated shared-app VMs, which run a root-owned gVisor supervisor, and the owner RPCs to install, edit, build and snapshot the app project. F7 is now resolved: the temp test installs a real project first, so readData itself refuses the symlinked tandem.json at open ('read app data', no secret in the error). The test also checks that a missing file gives undefined data and that a directory is refused. All test runs pass, the coverage gate passes with acceptable exemptions, and no findings remain.
